svg.title: Yunus OS: a pixel-art preview of the open-source workspace
svg.desc: Project card for Yunus OS, an open-source JavaScript workspace (MIT, no runtime dependencies) for your projects, GitHub activity and tasks, with an assistant that can talk back. Try it in your browser with no account, API key or install. A tiny pixel desktop plays the real flow: you type 'give me a workspace summary', the code graph lights up and the assistant reads the summary aloud. Then you type 'add a task: review PR feedback'; the assistant only proposes it and asks 'OK to add?', a cursor clicks 'Approve: add task', and the task lands with a green check. A gold coin pops out of the new task and the red-hooded hero from Yunus's game, sitting on the title, catches it.
svg.text: WITH AN ASSISTANT THAT CAN TALK BACK.
OPEN SOURCE · TRY IT IN YOUR BROWSER
NO ACCOUNT, API KEY OR INSTALL.
